_comment: Wise Sovren Nodes USDC, Ethereum mainnet. usd is Circle USDC; verify symbol() and decimals() on chain and record the date here before sign-off. wise stays zero: the burn hub is routed but never armed, and the bootstrap skips arming it while this is zero. thirdParty receives every deposit; verify with cast code whether it is an account or a contract and record that here before sign-off. worker receives swept overhang and is the deployer at launch, changeable later by the master through the timelocked worker flow. interestRate is 4000: the vault launches paying 40 percent, and the master lowers it to 20 percent about six months in with a plain setInterestRate call. The rate carries no per-holder checkpoint, so a cut prices each holder's un-banked accrual at the new rate; run syncInterestBulk first if the outgoing-rate window should be banked. totalDepositCap IS A PLACEHOLDER PENDING SIGN-OFF.
